notes: Fixes the reason updates kept failing silently. Needs one manual install; updates after this work in the app.

changelog.headline: What's new in 1.0.11

sections.title: Updates actually work now
items: Updates were failing silently every time — the app would download, restart, and come back on the old version. The space in the "ELLA Zero" folder name was breaking the command that copies new files into place.
This version needs a manual install once, because the version you're on can't fix its own updater. After that, updates happen in the app.

sections.title: Also included, from 1.0.10
items: Chess teacher mode explains every move and suggests your best next one.
Search checks how old an article is before calling something current, and filters out junk results.
When she says she'll check something, she actually does it and answers in the same breath.
She no longer thinks you're still on a page you already left.

changelog.data_safety: Your chats, memory, notes, portfolio and settings stay exactly as they are. This update only replaces the app's own program files. Nothing you have created is touched or deleted.
